description: Opening explorer. scope: "lichess" (community), "masters" (top 2200+ humans), "player" (single user). As of mid-2026 Lichess began requiring a Personal API Token on every explorer.lichess.ovh request — pass yours via _apiKey. Create one (free) at https://lichess.org/account/oauth/token; no scopes required for read-only Explorer access.

moves.description: Number of top moves to return (default 12, max 64).

play.description: UCI move list, comma-separated. Mutually exclusive with fen.
